title: Silicon Foundry Sabotage
subtitle: A Semiconductor Fabrication Mystery
summary: At 02:00 AM, cleanroom pressure sensors triggered an emergency lock alarm in Zone 2. Chief Lithography Engineer Kenji Sato was found crushed under the heavy mechanical arm of an EUV Wafer Stepper. Automated safety light curtains were disabled using an unauthorized admin security token. Expose the murderer!

suspects.name: David Miller
suspects.bio: Responsible for daily wafer yield targets and robotic maintenance schedules.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was reviewing production yield graphs in Fab Office 3.
suspects.motive: Kenji discovered David was falsifying wafer yield statistics to secure his $500k performance bonus.

suspects.name: Elena Torres
suspects.bio: Optimizes chemical photoresist formulas for 2nm chip production.
suspects.alibi: Testing chemical purity samples in Wet Lab A.
suspects.motive: Kenji rejected Elena's proposed photoresist formula, blaming it for wafer defect spikes.

suspects.name: OptiFab-3
suspects.bio: Heavy robotic manipulator programmed to transport silicon wafers.
suspects.motive: Programmed to clear physical obstructions to prevent wafer batch spoilage.

suspects.name: Arthur Vance
suspects.bio: Handles patent litigation for Nanowave Fab.
suspects.alibi: Reviewing non-disclosure agreements in the executive lounge.
suspects.motive: Kenji was planning to leave Nanowave to launch a competing startup in South Korea.
